title: IAM Settings
description: Represents an IAM security setting (e.g. password policy, MFA configuration, session timeout).

type.description: Stable dot-separated path identifying the setting.

tenantId.description: The id of the tenant that owns this setting.

category.description: GTS well-known instance identifier of the settings category.

properties.description: Type-specific settings data; see derived type schema.

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the actor who last changed this setting.
